source: 15_MODEL_INTERFACES!A125:I125 FRM-002 (WORKFLOW LOCKED / CHANNEL NUMERICS OPEN; 98_DECISION_LOG!A91; 26_BLENDER_CONTRACT C-017/C-018), refining 15!A117:I117 FLIGHT-FRAMES (98!A85)
rules: Sheets owns the numbers, states, units, sample times and validation flags; Claude imports, stages and replays only. UNKNOWN channels and streams carry null, never a number; no interpolation, resampling onto the 30 fps frames, smoothing or derived physics; untimed phases and events stay unplaced (15!G125, H125; C-017/C-018). Mission time is independent of the 24/30 fps presentation. The 1D route frames stay DIAGNOSTIC and not heliocentric (15!I117).
table: A released continuous table (C-017): row 1 the field names, row 2 the units, then one row per owner sample. Columns: mission_t_s, the channel column, scenario_id, scenario_version, status, source, validation, and optionally frame. One scenario_id and one scenario_version; mission_t_s strictly increasing; a frame, where given, is the 23_ROUTE_FRAMES frame at that mission_t_s; status one of WORKING / DERIVED / DIAGNOSTIC; validation PASS (the owner's test result) on every row. Refused otherwise, never fixed.
stream_table: A released phase or event table (C-018): row 1 the field names, row 2 the units. Phases: phase_id, start_mission_t_s, end_mission_t_s; events: event_id, mission_t_s; both with scenario_id, scenario_version, status, source, validation. A time may be empty (an unknown onset or duration): the row stays untimed and unplaced, never interpolated. Refused otherwise.
